# Street air quality: catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_catalogue.py from the code; do not edit by hand. -->

Street-canyon networks: canyon exchange, junction routing, above-roof plumes, chemistry and exposure (SIRANE and MUNICH physics, case readers and writers). How the pieces fit together: [Street air quality](../../applications/street/index.md).
Every application is set up the same way; see [Workflow](../../guide/workflow.md).

Import from `noodl.apps.street_aq`. Each name links to its entry in the [API reference](../api/index.md), which gives every parameter.

## Model options

Keyword arguments of `build_model` choosing the physics; a preset (`preset=`, one of `sirane`, `munich`) sets them all, and any given explicitly overrides it. A value marked with a preset's name is that preset's choice. Defined in `noodl.apps.street_aq.closures`.

| Option | Values | What it chooses |
|---|---|---|
| `canyon_wind` | `bessel_profile` (sirane)<br>`exponential_profile` (munich) | the along-canyon velocity. `bessel_profile` is the Soulhac, Perkins and Salizzoni (2008) closed form on the friction velocity; `exponential_profile` is the single-regime exponential profile on the roof-level wind (Kim et al. 2022, Eq. B14). |
| `roof_wind` | `bessel_canyon_mean` (sirane, munich)<br>`canopy_log_law` | the roof-level wind `u_H` the exponential profile needs. `bessel_canyon_mean` is the canyon mean of the Bessel profile (Kim et al. 2022, Eq. B12); `canopy_log_law` is a log law with Macdonald's (1998) displacement height and roughness. |
| `roof_exchange` | `turbulent_velocity` (sirane)<br>`aspect_ratio_scaled` (munich) | the roof exchange velocity. `turbulent_velocity` is `u_d = sigma_w / (sqrt(2) pi)`; `aspect_ratio_scaled` is Schulte's `u_d = beta sigma_w / (1 + H/W)`. |
| `junction_routing` | `non_crossing_streamlines` (sirane, munich)<br>`perfect_mixing` | how a junction's inflows are shared among its outflows. `non_crossing_streamlines` fills the outflows in angular order without crossing; `perfect_mixing` shares every inflow in proportion to the outflows. |
| `direction_averaging` | `none`<br>`exact_gaussian` (sirane)<br>`rectangle_rule` (munich)<br>`gauss_hermite` | the average of the junction routing over the wind-direction spread. `none` routes at the mean direction; `exact_gaussian` is the exact Gaussian average of the piecewise-constant routing; `rectangle_rule` is uniform sampling on `[-2 sigma, 2 sigma]` with unnormalised weights; `gauss_hermite` is an `n_theta`-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature. |
| `direction_spread` | `driver` (sirane)<br>`turbulence_intensity` (munich) | where the spread `sigma_theta` comes from. `driver` takes the `sigma_theta` driver, else the constructor value, else 0; `turbulence_intensity` is `sigma_theta = min(sigma_v / U_ref, 10 deg)`. |
| `stability` | `neutral`<br>`monin_obukhov` (sirane, munich) | the turbulence profiles. `neutral` is `sigma_w = 1.3 u* (1 - 0.8 z/h)`; `monin_obukhov` switches between unstable, neutral and stable branches on the Obukhov length, and is the neutral form wherever no `lmo` driver is given. |
| `sigma_w_height` | `canopy_height` (sirane)<br>`street_height` (munich) | the height at which the `sigma_w` of the roof exchange velocity is evaluated. `canopy_height` is one network-wide height above ground, `h_canopy` (SIRANE's `H_R`), the same for every street; `street_height` is each street's own height `H`. |
| `shape_constant` | `exact_root` (sirane)<br>`grid_search` (munich) | how the shape parameter `c` of the Bessel canyon profile is evaluated. `exact_root` solves the shape equation to machine precision; `grid_search` takes the point of the grid `c = 0.01, ..., 1.00` with the smallest residual, as MUNICH does (forward value quantised to 0.01, gradient of the exact root). |

Numeric settings each preset fixes (each also a `build_model` keyword):

| Setting | `sirane` | `munich` |
|---|---|---|
| `kappa` | `0.4` | `0.41` |
| `canyon_wind_min` | `0.0` | `0.1` |
| `u_d_min` | `0.0` | `0.001` |
| `sigma_w_min` | `0.3` | `0.0` |
| `sigma_v_min` | `0.5` | `0.0` |
| `h_canopy` | `20.0` | `20.0` |

## Set-up

Build the model and its starting state and inputs.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`build_model`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.network.build_model) | `(Model, initial state, driver template)` for one street network. |
| [`initial_drivers`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.network.initial_drivers) | `build_model`'s driver template (copied), then `values` by name (see `noodl.refs.drivers_from`), e.g. by street and species name. |
| [`initial_state`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.network.initial_state) | Zero concentration everywhere, in each transport layer's own shape; then `values` by street and species name (see `noodl.refs.state_from`): `initial_state(model, values={"street": {"s1": {"nox": 1e-7}}})`. |

## Network components

Descriptions of the physical objects a network is built from.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`PlumeTable`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.plume.PlumeTable) | One plume trajectory per hour, resampled onto a distance grid (`plume_table`). |
| [`PuffOptions`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.PuffOptions) | The options of the unsteady above-roof puff model, `build_model(..., puffs=PuffOptions(...))`: canopy height `h_canopy`, `z0`, `d` (m), puff slots `capacity` per instance, emission interval `puff_dt` (s), faint threshold `drop_below` (design Sect. 4.2-4.8). |
| [`PuffState`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.PuffState) | The puffs of `B` batch instances in `K` fixed slots, and the mass counters. |
| [`PuffTables`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.PuffTables) | The plume trajectory on the steady kernel's distance grid, read by age (`puff_tables`). |
| [`Street`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.network.Street) | One street segment between junctions `u` and `v` (the azimuth points `u -> v`): its `length`, `width` and building `height` (m), the roughness length of its building walls `z0_b` (m, 0.15 by default) and `emission_scale`, a dimensionless factor applied to its emissions. |
| [`StreetCase`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.case.StreetCase) | One street-network case: the network plus every array a `Model` built on it needs to run, independent of which source model (`source`) it came from. |
| [`StreetResults`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.case.StreetResults) | One street model's own results, read format-neutral by `read_results` from a SIRANE result directory or a MUNICH `results/` directory. |
| [`StreetGeometry`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.routing.StreetGeometry) | Everything `StreetFlows` needs about the streets, as plain tensors. |
| [`StreetNetwork`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.network.StreetNetwork) | Streets plus the x/y coordinates (metres) of every junction they name. |

## Layers and model

The conservation layers and the model that steps them.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`BoundaryLayer`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.canyon.BoundaryLayer) | Friction velocity and the turbulence it sets, batched over forcing instances. |

## Closures

Functions of the state that compute drivers each step (densities, flows, levels).

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`PuffClosure`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.PuffClosure) | The unsteady above-roof model as an integrating closure of the street model (design Sect. 4.5): it writes `"<layer>.x_boundary"` = `C_ext` per street, the caller's `"<layer>.x_boundary"` driver (`C_bg`, read afresh every step) plus the puffs at each street midpoint at roof level (a street's own puffs excluded, as `street_kernel` does). |
| [`StreetFlows`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.routing.StreetFlows) | The closure that turns the wind drivers into every prescribed edge flow. |

## Reactions

Transformations applied to transported species each step.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`Photostationary`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.reactions.Photostationary) | NO/NO2/O3 relaxed to the Leighton photostationary state, in closed form. |

## Sources and storage

Nodal sources, withdrawals and storage.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`PulseSource`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.PulseSource) | An explicit pulse release into the street canopy: `"pulse.rate"` (kg/s) from `"pulse.start"` for `"pulse.duration"` (s), added to the streets' sources (design Sect. 4.2). |

## Files

Readers and writers of other tools' file formats.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`read_case`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.case.read_case) | `StreetCase` from `path`: a directory holding `munich.cfg` is read as a MUNICH case; a `.dat` file is read as a SIRANE master file (`Donnees_*.dat`) with the deck it names (see `_sirane_files.read_sirane_case` for what is read and what is refused). |
| [`read_results`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.case.read_results) | `StreetResults` from `path`: a SIRANE result directory (holding `RUES_PAR_HEURE/` and `METEO/Resul_Meteo.dat`) or a MUNICH `results/` directory of `<species>.bin` files (see `_sirane_files.read_sirane_results`, `_munich_files.read_munich_results` for what each reads). |
| [`write_case`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.case.write_case) | Writes `case` under `out_dir` in `format` (`"munich"` or `"sirane"`), and returns `out_dir`. |
| [`write_network_concentration`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.report.write_network_concentration) | Write a `network_concentration_<year>.nc` of per-street results, as classic CDF. |
| [`write_sweep`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.case.write_sweep) | Writes a sweep of SIRANE decks under `out_dir` -- one per (direction, speed, source street, variant) -- plus `runs.csv`, a manifest of each deck's parameters; returns `out_dir`. |

## Functions

Calculations and helpers.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`advance`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.advance) | Every live puff `dt` (s) older and moved along the wind `theta_w` (scalar or `(B,)`, radians counter-clockwise from east, toward) by its table's distance increment `x(a + dt) - x(a)`: exact for any `dt`, since `x` is the exact travel distance at the table's speed, so under constant wind the displacement is `x(a)`. |
| [`bessel_shape_parameter`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.canyon.bessel_shape_parameter) | The shape parameter `c` of the Bessel canyon profile: the root of `bessel_shape_residual`, batched and differentiable in `ratio`. |
| [`boundary_layer`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.canyon.boundary_layer) | Friction velocity and the boundary-layer height from the network-mean geometry and reference wind, batched and differentiable. |
| [`canopy_displacement_roughness`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.canyon.canopy_displacement_roughness) | Macdonald (1998) displacement height and roughness length, `(d_c, z0c)`, in metres. |
| [`canyon_velocity`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.canyon.canyon_velocity) | The SIGNED along-canyon velocity, m/s. |
| [`concentration_at`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.concentration_at) | `(B, R)`: the puffs' concentration (kg/m3) at `points` `(R, 3)` (x, y, z in m), as `roof_concentration` but at each point's own height and without the clamp (SIRANE's roof-level device), and with no receptor excluded. |
| [`direction_offsets`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.routing.direction_offsets) | Wind-direction samples and their weights, `(offsets (..., m), weights (..., m))`. |
| [`downwind_cutoff`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.plume.downwind_cutoff) | SIRANE's downwind cut-off, m: `meteo_cell_dx / \|cos theta_w\|`, the x-size of the meteo-grid cell over the cosine of the wind's angle to the x axis (an empirical rule: 900 m cells give 910 m, 700 m cells 700 m whatever the cells' y-size, and a wind at 45 degrees to the axis ~1020 m; `\|cos\|` is floored at 1e-6). |
| [`drivers_at`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.case.drivers_at) | The driver mapping at time index `k` for `model`, built from `case`. |
| [`emit`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.emit) | One new puff per source with non-zero mass in `masses` `(B, S)` (kg, signed), written into the first free slots of its instance in source order: age `age` (s, default 0), table `table_index[s]` (`(S,)`), displacement zero, except a release's, which is its position in `release_xy` `(B, R, 2)` (m) relative to its `source_xy0`. |
| [`exact_gaussian_direction_samples`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.routing.exact_gaussian_direction_samples) | The EXACT Gaussian direction average of the junction routing, as samples and weights `(offsets (..., n_j, m), weights (..., n_j, m))` -- SIRANE's `P^_ij(phi0) = int f(phi - phi0) P_ij(phi) dphi` (Soulhac et al. 2011, Atmos. Environ. 45:7379, Eq. 7) with `f` the normal density of standard deviation `sigma_theta`. |
| [`exchange_velocity`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.canyon.exchange_velocity) | The roof exchange velocity `u_d`, m/s. |
| [`grid_shape_parameter`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.canyon.grid_shape_parameter) | The shape parameter `c` the way MUNICH evaluates it: the point of the grid `c = 0.01, 0.02, ..., 1.00` that minimises `\|2/c exp((pi/2) Y1(c)/J1(c) - gamma_E) - z0/di\|` (ATM `ComputeSiraneC`, `MeteorologyStreet.cxx:114-152`; the first minimum wins on a tie, as MUNICH's strict `>` makes it). |
| [`exposure_reduction_adjoint`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.exposure.exposure_reduction_adjoint) | Exposure reduction from cutting each listed street's emission by `delta_fraction` of their mean, to first order, from ONE steady solve and one backward pass (the adjoint); compare `exposure_reduction_forward`. |
| [`exposure_reduction_forward`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.exposure.exposure_reduction_forward) | The same exposure reductions as `exposure_reduction_adjoint`, by brute force: one steady solve per street with that street's emission cut (`len(streets) + 1` solves, no linearisation). |
| [`from_test_network`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.network.from_test_network) | A fixed four-junction, three-street test geometry. |
| [`from_ug_m3`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.report.from_ug_m3) | ug/m3 -> kg/m3. |
| [`housekeep`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.housekeep) | Retire puffs (design Sect. 4.8). |
| [`j_no2_elevation_cloud`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.chemistry.j_no2_elevation_cloud) | SIRANE's NO2 photolysis rate `k1` (1/s) at solar elevation `elevation_deg` under `cloud_octas` of cloud (0 to 8). |
| [`j_no2_zenith_table`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.chemistry.j_no2_zenith_table) | Clear-sky `J_NO2` [1/s] at `zenith_deg`, times `attenuation`. |
| [`junction_kernel`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.plume.junction_kernel) | `batch + (n_streets, n_junctions)`: `C_ext` above street `i` (at its midpoint) per unit vertical-flux rate out of junction `j`, s/m3 -- SIRANE's intersection plume (Soulhac et al. 2011, Sect. 5.2: `C_ext` sums the contributions of upwind streets AND intersections), each junction one point source of `junction_sources`' width and clamp. |
| [`junction_sources`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.plume.junction_sources) | `(xy (J, 2), width (J,), clamp (J,))`: every junction as one point source of width `W_j` and clamp `1/H_j`, with `W_j`, `H_j` the mean width and height of the streets that meet at the junction. |
| [`k_no_o3_jpl2003`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.reactions.k_no_o3_jpl2003) | k(NO + O3) = 3.0e-12 exp(-1500/T) cm3 molecule^-1 s^-1, returned in m3 mol^-1 s^-1. |
| [`k_no_o3_soulhac2011`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.chemistry.k_no_o3_soulhac2011) | k(NO + O3) = 1.325e6 exp(-1430/T) m3 mol^-1 s^-1 at `temperature` (K), SIRANE's rate (Soulhac et al. 2011, with the prefactor that reproduces SIRANE v2.1 output). |
| [`mass_in_streets`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.mass_in_streets) | `(B,)`: the street network's mass in excess of the background, kg: `sum_s V_s (x_s - C_bg,s)` from the state's `"<layer>.x"` `(..., n_streets)` and `c_bg` (the background, broadcasting with it), with `V_s` the layer's capacity (the street volumes). |
| [`molar_volume`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.reactions.molar_volume) | The ideal-gas molar volume `R T / P`, m3/mol, at `temperature` (K) and `pressure` (Pa). |
| [`n_theta_rectangle_rule`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.routing.n_theta_rectangle_rule) | The sample count of the `rectangle_rule` direction average: `ntheta = floor(sigma_theta in DEGREES)` (MUNICH, SRC `:3568`), as a long tensor, clamped to `[1, 10]`. |
| [`node_closure`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.routing.node_closure) | MUNICH's roof closure at an intersection, before any routing (SRC `:2980-3014`). |
| [`pending_roof_mass`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.pending_roof_mass) | `(emitted, drawn_down)`, each `(B,)`, kg: what the puff closure's next step will add to `mass_emitted` from the roof and junction fluxes of the last step, and to `mass_drawn_down`, computed as the closure does (`roof_fluxes` of `"puff.q"`, `"puff.c_ext"` and the state's `"<layer>.x"` against the background `c_bg`, times the last step's length `"puff.time"[1]`). |
| [`photostationary_for_streets`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.chemistry.photostationary_for_streets) | The Leighton reaction wired to the `"no"`, `"no2"` and `"o3"` columns of `species`. |
| [`plume_kernel`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.plume.plume_kernel) | Concentration at each receptor per unit rate at each source, s/m3: `batch + (R, P)`. |
| [`plume_table`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.plume.plume_table) | SIRANE's plume trajectory for each hour, resampled onto a 10 m grid (module docstring: the table). |
| [`puff_mass`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.puff_mass) | `(B,)`: the summed mass of the live puffs, kg. |
| [`puff_tables`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.puff_tables) | SIRANE's plume trajectory on the steady kernel's distance grid (module docstring), one table per entry of `centres`. |
| [`pulse_mass`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.pulse_mass) | Mass (kg) of a top-hat release inside the step `[t, t + dt]`. |
| [`roof_concentration`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.puff.roof_concentration) | `(B, R)`: the puffs' concentration (kg/m3) at roof level `H_R` above `receptors_xy` `(R, 2)`, design Sect. 4.3: per sub-source `m w_i g_x f_y min(P_z, clamp_i)`, with `g_x` the slug of the puff's age `a`, `[x(a - dt/2), x(a + dt/2)]` along the wind `theta_w` from its source (`dt`, s, the emission interval: the step, or `PuffOptions.puff_dt`; consecutive puffs of a continuous source tile the axis), and `f_y` and the table's `p_z` read at the receptor's own distance from the source (`_evaluate`). |
| [`roof_wind`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.canyon.roof_wind) | Wind speed at roof level `u_H`, from the friction velocity. |
| [`routing_matrix`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.routing.routing_matrix) | The street-to-street flux matrix `F[..., p, r]` from ORDERED, closed marginals. |
| [`shape_parameter`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.canyon.shape_parameter) | The Bessel shape parameter `c`, by the `shape_constant` closure option: `"exact_root"` is `bessel_shape_parameter` (the continuous root), `"grid_search"` is `grid_shape_parameter` (MUNICH's argmin on a 0.01 grid). |
| [`sigma_theta_turbulence_intensity`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.routing.sigma_theta_turbulence_intensity) | `sigma_theta = min(sigma_v / U, 10 deg)` (SRC `:3567`; Blackadar 1997, Soulhac 2009), the `direction_spread="turbulence_intensity"` spread. |
| [`solar_elevation`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.chemistry.solar_elevation) | The solar elevation (degrees) at `latitude_deg`, day `day_of_year` (1 January = 1) and clock time `hour` (fractional hours), in SIRANE's convention. |
| [`source_points`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.plume.source_points) | Each street's roof flux as SIRANE's sub-sources: a street `u -> v` of coordinate length `L` is cut into `n = floor(L / SUBSOURCE_LENGTH_M) + 1` equal segments with one sub-source at the centre of each, weight `1/n`, width `(L/n)\|sin phi\|` and clamp `min(CLAMP_LENGTH_M / W, 1/(H (1 - \|sin phi\|)))`, where `phi` is the angle between the street and the wind `theta_w` (radians counter-clockwise from east, the direction the wind blows TOWARD; any batch shape) and `W`, `H` the street's width and height. |
| [`street_geometry`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.network.street_geometry) | The plain-tensor view of `net` that `StreetFlows` consumes. |
| [`street_index`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.network.street_index) | Street name -> its row of `"<layer>.x"`. |
| [`street_kernel`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.plume.street_kernel) | `batch + (n_streets, n_streets)`: `K[..., i, j]` is `C_ext` above street `i` (at its midpoint) per unit roof-flux rate of street `j`, s/m3. |
| [`street_population`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.exposure.street_population) | p_i = n_total * H_i L_i / sum_j H_j L_j (their eq. 6 with a common building depth and storey height, which cancel). |
| [`street_steady`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.chemistry.street_steady) | The steady state of transport AND chemistry, by an explicit fixed point. |
| [`street_steady_with_plume`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.above_roof.street_steady_with_plume) | The steady state of the street network with `C_ext` from the above-roof plumes. |
| [`to_ug_m3`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.report.to_ug_m3) | kg/m3 -> ug/m3. |
| [`total_exposure`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.exposure.total_exposure) | Population-weighted inhaled dose rate, `sum_i q p_i c_i`: breathing rate `q` times each street's population `p_i` times its concentration `c_i`. |
| [`twelve_street_grid`](../api/street.md#noodl.apps.street_aq.network.twelve_street_grid) | The 12-street network of Kim et al. 2022 Fig. 1, p. 7374. |
